channel.title: The Drill Down: Arizona Cardinals
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 11: Cardinals at Chiefs
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: KC -16.5 · O/U 41.5 | Model KC 84% vs. market 89% | Arizona must turn trips into touchdowns against Kansas City's top-ranked red-zone defense, which allows 48%, while the Cardinals convert only 54% of their own trips, so every stalled drive costs them. Travis Kelce, who averages 3.9 yards of separation, runs into an Arizona pass defense ranked 28th, a matchup that favors Kansas City's passing game. Our model, at 84%, sits below the market's Kansas City price, with the passing matchup doing most of the work.

item.title: Week 10: Rams at Cardinals
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 4:05 PM ET | Line: LA -9.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model ARI 18% vs. market 19% | Keep the pocket clean decides this one, since Los Angeles has the 2nd-best pass protection while Arizona's defense ranks 32nd in generating pressure. Puka Nacua soaks up 31% of the Rams' targets and will run into a pass defense that ranks 29th, so Arizona's secondary has to win in coverage on every route. Our model and the market nearly agree, with the model at 82% for the Rams against the market's 81%, and the rushing matchup leads our number.
